extracted.intended_audience: media creators (filmmakers, podcasters, journalists), cultural institutions, and the general public interested in Peabody Awards and recommended media
extracted.subtask_description: Landing/overview page for the Peabody Awards describing what the awards honor and the types of programming and resources available (winners, submissions, categories, juried selections). Intended to communicate the Awards' evaluative focus and areas of activity rather than detailed submission rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in storytelling that reflects social issues and emerging voices
rubrics_metrics.description: "Peabody Awards honors excellence in storytelling that reflects the social issues and the emerging voices of our day."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This mission statement is the primary evaluative standard presented on the page: entries should demonstrate outstanding storytelling quality and engage with contemporary social issues or amplify emerging voices. The site framing ("Stories That Matter", "Get the Media That Matters") reinforces emphasis on cultural significance and impact. No detailed scoring rubric or submission rules are provided on this landing page.
